profile.headline: Software Engineer at LinkedIn
profile.summary:
Anthony is an experienced software engineer with a strong track record of designing and delivering scalable, production‑grade systems across data, machine learning, and distributed platforms. He thrives on solving complex problems end‑to‑end—from system architecture and modeling to real‑world deployment and measurable impact.

Over the course of his career, Anthony has built deep expertise in data pipelines, feature engineering, machine learning systems, mobile security, connected devices, and large‑scale distributed systems through both academic research and industry experience. He combines hands‑on engineering with thoughtful technical leadership, driving solutions that are robust, extensible, and closely aligned with business outcomes.

Anthony is also an inventor with multiple patents. His work on a scalable, configuration‑free ubiquitous authentication model based on Bluetooth Low Energy was recognized with the Most Potential Award for Invention at CA Technologies. In addition, he has led teams to top placements in competitive innovation events, including a 3rd‑place finish at Vancouver Startup Week’s hackathon.

Earlier in his career, Anthony published award‑winning, peer‑reviewed research in peer‑to‑peer and distributed systems at prestigious academic conferences, reflecting a strong foundation in systems thinking and research‑driven problem solving.

Technical Focus
Distributed systems • Data platforms • Machine learning & recommendation systems • Forecasting & ranking • Ads systems • Security & authentication • Low‑latency services

Core Technologies
Java, Scala, Python
Spark, Kafka, Presto
RESTful APIs • OAuth • SSL/PKI
